name: Schedules
description: The one place every recurring task is authored and listed. An agent asks it for a timed run of itself; it starts the conversation when the time comes, records the run and tells you about it.

tools.name: create
tools.title: Schedule a run
tools.description: Create a schedule that starts a conversation in an app at a time, with a prompt. spec is a five-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week): every minute is "* * * * *", every hour at minute 0 is "0 * * * *", every weekday at nine is "0 9 * * 1-5" and every second day at nine is "0 9 */2 * *"; once is one ISO date-time instead. The expression is read in timezone, the machine's own zone when none is given. prompt is what the app will be told when it fires, written as an instruction, because the fire opens a fresh conversation with that text and nothing else. catchUp is "once" to run a window the computer slept through, or "skip" to wait for the next one. The answer states the schedule in words with its next run: tell the person, so a wrong time shows.

title.description: A few words naming the schedule, as a person reads it in a list

prompt.description: What the app will be told when it fires

spec.description: A five-field cron expression; name this or once, never both

once.description: One ISO date-time to fire at; name this or spec, never both

timezone.description: An IANA zone name the expression is read in; the machine's own zone when omitted

app.description: The id of an installed app with an agent; leave it out to run in your own app

catchUp.description: What to do about a window the computer slept through; skip unless given

notify.description: Which runs tell the person: every one, only a failed one, or none; all unless given

tools.name: suggest
tools.title: Suggest a schedule
tools.description: Propose a schedule the person may approve on the Schedules page; nothing runs until they do. Same fields as create, plus a reason in one sentence.

app.description: The id of an installed app with an agent; leave it out to run in your own app

reason.description: Why this schedule is worth having, in one sentence

tools.name: list
tools.title: List the schedules
tools.description: Every schedule: its id, when it runs in words and as cron, the app it runs in, what it will say, whether it is on, and when it last ran.

tools.name: update
tools.title: Change a schedule
tools.description: Change a schedule by its id: retime it with spec or once, rewrite its title or prompt, move it to another app, change which runs notify, or switch it off and on. Only the fields given change.

once.description: One ISO date-time to fire at, in place of spec

app.description: The id of an installed app with an agent

tools.name: remove
tools.title: Remove a schedule
tools.description: Delete a schedule by its id. It stops at once.

tools.name: listing
tools.title: Read every schedule
tools.description: Every schedule with its rhythm in words and the name of its app, every run newest first, and the suggestions that wait.

tools.name: apps
tools.title: Read the apps a schedule runs in
tools.description: The enabled apps with an agent, each with its id, name and icon.

tools.name: choices
tools.title: Read an app's models and projects
tools.description: The models and projects a schedule of one app may run on and in, and the model the app runs on by itself.

tools.name: words
tools.title: Read a rhythm in words
tools.description: A cron expression in the words a person reads; one that does not parse is refused with the reason.

tools.name: add
tools.title: Make a schedule
tools.description: Makes a schedule from the view's form; its expression is read in timezone.

app.description: The id of the app the schedule runs in

model.description: A model card; empty for the app's own choice

project.description: A project of the app; empty for none

once.description: One ISO date-time, in place of spec

tools.name: set
tools.title: Save a schedule
tools.description: Saves the fields the patch gives, or switches the schedule off and on; the rest stay.

app.description: The id of the app the schedule runs in

model.description: A model card; empty for the app's own choice

project.description: A project of the app; empty for none

once.description: One ISO date-time, in place of spec

tools.name: delete
tools.title: Delete a schedule
tools.description: Deletes a schedule and its record of runs. It stops at once.

tools.name: runNow
tools.title: Run a schedule now
tools.description: Starts the conversation the schedule asks for now, outside its time.

tools.name: dismiss
tools.title: Dismiss a suggestion
tools.description: Removes the suggestion; the same one is not suggested again.
